summary: The glossary holds two Approved entries for 'Trade Date' (GL-301 v1.3 and GL-302 v1.1) that agree a Trade Date is the date a trade is executed but disagree on when it is booked: same business day (T+0) versus the following business day (T+1). They are linked in the glossary as possible_duplicate. No single definition can be given without picking one source over the other, so both are surfaced and the conflict is escalated to a human Data Steward. This agent does not choose between them, assign an owner, or declare CDE status.
